programme.title: Qurbani Annual Programme 2026 - Central Mahallu
programme.guidelines: 1. Standard 7 shares per cattle. 2. Payments must be verified 48 hours prior to slaughter day. 3. Distribution tokens required for meat collection.

expenses.description: Procurement of 10 Holstein & Gir bulls from Mandi
Mandi broker commission dalal fee for livestock purchase
Dry hay and green wheat straw fodder bales (40 bags)
Drinking water tanker delivery for animal holding shed
Mineral salt licks and wheat bran nutrition feed
Advance paid to chief butcher kasab for Day 1 slaughter teams
Slaughter site cutting staff and dressing labor charges
Cleaver and butchery knife blade sharpening service
Heavy-duty food-grade polythene meat bags (5,000 pcs)
Corrugated distribution packing cartons with handles
Food preservation ice blocks and cooling crates
Tata Ace and mini truck freight transport from Mandi
Diesel fuel allowance for meat distribution delivery vans
Animal unloading hamali and porter carriage charges
Municipal carcass and offal waste disposal dumping fee
Bleaching powder, lime, phenyl and floor disinfectant
Colour-coded registration tokens, receipt books and flex banners
Refreshments, tea, breakfast and water bottles for 30 volunteers
Emergency electrical extension boards, ropes and sundry site accessories
